notes.title: Many Small Updates
notes.notes:
[p]We've made lots of little changes to the game over the last year.
Here's a summary:

- On mobile web/Android there's a "keyboard controls" button that lets you use certain features that previously only worked via keyboard shortcuts.
- Added a sword for slashing 3D objects (press C to slash, M/N to rotate)

Deluxe Only:
- Pen pressure should work correctly with more tablets now.
- You can now clear you painting easel
- Added 3 easel slots accessible via the lever to the right of the easel.
- You can now send gallery paintings to your easel even after you start drawing on them.
- You can now zoom in on other people's finished paintings using the same controls
- On mobile you can now pinch to zoom the canvas.
- You can rotate the canvas while painting with M/N
- From the game build folder You can put custom textures in 
    DifferentStrokes_Data\\StreamingAssets\\Brushes
    and
    DifferentStrokes_Data\\StreamingAssets\\Patterns
  to use those textures as brushes or paint bucket fill patterns.
  you can cycle through them using R
  the images must be 64x64 or smaller


[/p]

notes.title: New-ish feature. Production Update
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Just wanted to officially announce a feature that's been in the game for a while now, but I was planning to wait until the big update to announce it. 
If you have the Deluxe Edition, when you're in paint bucket mode (G) if you press R or T it will cycle through a list of patterns. Wherever you click will be filled with that pattern. There's also a checkbox to invert the pattern. 
Finally, in paint bucket mode, if you hold Q and then draw a shape, it will fill that shape in with the current pattern.

The big update is still in the works, but I want to get my other game "Kingdom of Night" done before I come back to work seriously on Different Strokes.

It's coming together nicely now. The script has about 100,000 words in it which explains why it's taken so long to finish. Check it out and if it looks like something you'd be interested in, please wishlist it!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094600/Kingdom_of_Night/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094600/Kingdom_of_Night/[/url]

notes.title: Canvas Zoom Feature and Improved Mobile Controls
notes.notes:
It's now possible to zoom into the canvas for more fine detail work.
To zoom hold ALT on the keyboard and use the mouse scroll wheel.
Alternatively hold ALT and press the [ or ] keys.
When zoomed in you can use the arrow keys, or hold the cursor on the edge of the screen to move the view around.

The web version mobile controls are improved and allow you move and look around at the same time. 
Web Version: [url=https://swsteffes.itch.io/different-strokes]https://swsteffes.itch.io/different-strokes[/url]

notes.title: Mobile version and a fun minigame.
notes.notes:
The web version of the game now supports touch controls, so if you have a fairly recent Android/iOS device you should be able to load it up, walk around the gallery and paint using the touchscreen.
Touch the left side of the screen to move and the right side to look around.
The web version doesn't support Steam login so you'll have to create a non-steam account in the game if you want to be logged in. If you have the deluxe edition and would like to use it in the web version, message me in the Discord and I'll give it to your web account.

Web/Mobile version: [url=https://swsteffes.itch.io/different-strokes]https://swsteffes.itch.io/different-strokes[/url]

Discord Invite: [url=https://discord.gg/7r7MtVmEnh]https://discord.gg/7r7MtVmEnh[/url]

Speaking of the Discord, I collaborated with the artist Drenn from the Discord to make this little minigame that is a reference to an ongoing joke in the community. 
I think it's pretty fun, and it has an online leaderboard!

[url=https://swsteffes.itch.io/cat-stack]https://swsteffes.itch.io/cat-stack[/url]

You can now toggle run/walk by tapping the shift key.

notes.title: Updates & Steam Summer Sale
notes.notes:
The Deluxe Edition is half off for the Steam Summer Sale!

Changes since the last update:
[list]
[*] You no longer have to hold shift to run, you just run all the time now.
[*] If you right click, or alt+click on a canvas while painting, it will change to the color under your cursor (eyedropper tool)
[*] Straight Line Tool (Deluxe Edition Only). If you hold shift before you begin a line it will draw a straight line until you release the mouse/pen. While drawing a straight line, if you release the shift key and then press it again, it will lock the line to multiples of 22.5 degrees.
[/list]
As always, don't forget to check the "Controls" page in the pause menu to see all of the additional features that are only accessible as keyboard shortcuts!

Also, in case you didn't know, there's a web version of the game that runs in the browser! You can't use your steam login, but I use it all the time just to quickly browse the gallery.
[url=https://swsteffes.itch.io/different-strokes]https://swsteffes.itch.io/different-strokes[/url]

notes.title: More Small Changes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The top 6 paintings from the Gallery of the Week, appear in the main game around the GotW portal.
[*] Added a "controls" page to the pause menu describing all the keyboard controls.
[*] The 0-6 keys can now be used to toggle through all the colors (see controls page)
[*] Added UI pieces to indicate the currently selected color when using the Brush or Paint Bucket tool.
[*] Made the server faster again to handle the 651,218 paintings submitted so far.
[/list]

notes.title: Lots of small updates!
notes.notes:
Changes since the last update:
[list]
[*]Steam achievements!
[*]Significant server performance improvements.
[*]In the pause menu there is now a "Graphics Settings" button, which takes you to a new screen where you can set the game's resolution.
[*]Added a little text to the bottom of the painting UI to indicate the gallery of the week theme if you're in the gallery of the week.
[*]Added a confirm yes/no step when you click Upload on a painting.
[*]Added experimental support for Redo. There's no button in the UI, but if you have undone changes(CTRL + Z), you can redo them by pressing (CTRL + SHIFT + Z) or (CTRL + Y)
[*]There is now a "remove from my likes" button on the paintings in the "My Likes" section. Clicking this will remove the painting from appearing in your "My Likes" but it does NOT subtract your like from the painting's like total.
[*]It's now possible to open the settings menu while you're painting by pressing 'p' This makes it possible to turn pen pressure on and off while you're painting.
[*]For Deluxe users there is now a new brush 0 that is a small as it can possibly be before you start getting dotted lines. The old size 0 is now size 1, size 1 is 2 etc...
[*]For Deluxe users there is now a "Send to Easel" button on all paintings that have only been painted once. This will allow you to send that painting to your studio easel where you can paint on it and use the "save draft" functionality. Remember that this will clear whatever is currently on your easel.
[/list]

notes.title: Dark Mode! And several small updates
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] In the pause menu there is now a checkbox for "Dark Mode" which makes most of the 3D models in the game black instead of white. This should hopefully help reduce eye strain.
[*] There is now a "restart" button in the pause menu which restarts the gallery and updates your "my likes", "my paintings" and the notification icon in the upper right corner of the login kiosk.
[*] When logged in, the login kiosk now has a "my paintings" button that opens your user page on the website.
[*] The Deluxe Edition now has a checkbox for "pen pressure" This is not guaranteed to work and will only work if "Windows Ink" is ENABLED in your tablet driver's settings.
[/list]

As always, join us in the Discord for more frequent updates! There are a ton of amazing artist in there as well!
[url=https://discord.gg/7r7MtVmEnh]https://discord.gg/7r7MtVmEnh[/url]
